title: The Toad Who Taxed the Moonpears
story: High on the Gullwind Market ledge, a bloated toad in a tax-collector's hat squats on the only gate, croaking prices at anyone carrying food to the hungry hamlet below. Mr 6 needs 8 crates of moonpears, priced at 12.5 sunspur coins each. He flashes a caravan token that takes 10% off the crates — but Quibblenox slaps a 15% tariff on whatever price Mr 6 ends up paying.
question: How many sunspur coins must Mr 6 hand over in total?
solution: 8 crates × 12.5 = 100 sunspur coins before any deals.
The tariff adds 15% of 90: 90 + 13.5 = 103.5 sunspur coins.
praise: Taking the discount first was smart bookkeeping — the tariff just had to be added on top of the NEW price, not left off the end.
hint: Find the plain cost of 8 crates first, then apply the discount, and only then let the toad add his 15%.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 103.5 coins so precisely that Quibblenox, who had been overcharging for years, blushed a deep swampy green and waved the moonpear cart through for free. The hamlet ate fruit pie for a week.
imagePrompt: A huge bespectacled toad in a tax-collector's hat guarding a windy cliff-ledge market gate, while a small numeral-six knight coolly stacks glowing coins on a barrel beside crates of silvery moonpears at sunset.
